what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Guatemala in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 138420 asylum seekers from Guatemala.
The United States hosts the largest share, 95.6%, followed by Mexico, Canada and Belize.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guatemala in 1995, with the URNG.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in the later years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew again.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 101803 asylum seekers, and the figure then fell to a low in 2010.
It rose again from the late 2010s and reached its highest point, 195319, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2001 and 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Guatemala are counted separately.
